title: Voice assistant
description: Talk to the workbench. The heavy work runs on the family server (the voice hub: speech to text and text to speech through speaches, Home Assistant for home commands); devices only listen and speak. In CO Web a 🗣 button in the composer: home commands are answered aloud at once, anything else goes into the chat and the agent's answer is read aloud. On a PC or a small Linux box a voice point with a wake word (off until the device's owner turns it on). Optional speaker recognition: the wake word answers only enrolled voices, the hub routes a recognised voice to that person's chat and gives strangers home commands only.
isolationReason: a voice point needs the device's microphone and speaker

data.home: hub config and point settings (no secrets)
